claims.quote: The black neon tetra, Hyphessobrycon herbertaxelrodi, is a characid from the upper rio Paraguai in Mato Grosso and Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil.
This South American fish comes from the Paraguay River basin in Brazil.

Records of a fish identified as H. cf. herbertaxelrodi from Noel Kempff Mercado National Park in the upper Guaporé, at the border between Bolivia and Brazil, suggest that it might also share this pattern of distribution.

regions.quote: The black neon tetra, Hyphessobrycon herbertaxelrodi, is a characid from the upper rio Paraguai in Mato Grosso and Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil.

regions.name: Pantanal
regions.quote: It is widespread north and south of the Pantanal, favouring minor tributaries, headwater rivers, oxbows and seasonal floodplains.

regions.name: Taquari
regions.quote: Type locality is 'Coxim on the Rio Taquary [= Taquari], Rio Paraguay [= Paraguai] basin, Mato Grosso, Brazil'.

regions.name: Sepotuba
regions.quote: The Sepotuba empties into the Paraguai main channel around 500 kilometres upstream of the Taquiri, thus the species is assumed to occur in other drainages between them.
